live_claims.text: EEG-FM-Bench curates 14 public datasets spanning 10 canonical EEG paradigms with standardized preprocessing and evaluation (Figure 1).
The benchmark evaluates frozen-backbone single-task fine-tuning, full-parameter single-task fine-tuning, and full-parameter multi-task fine-tuning strategies (Figure 1).
Frozen-backbone evaluation exposes a generalization gap, with many EEG foundation models performing only slightly above chance on several tasks (Table 1).
Separate full-parameter fine-tuning substantially improves performance over frozen-backbone probing across the seven main BCI tasks (Table 2).
Qualitative t-SNE and Integrated Gradients analyses show stronger models forming clearer task clusters and focusing on neurophysiologically relevant channels (Figure 2).

value.title: EEG-FM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for the Systematic Evaluation and Diagnostic Analyses of EEG Foundation Models
